tab.help: The displayed area: the overview of the designs with the phase guide, the guided advisor or the comparison of the central composite designs. Every switch is a step that undo takes back.

currentStep.help: The id of the open question — phase (DMAIC phase), goal, screening-curvature (curvature in screening), factor-count (number of factors), factor-levels (levels of the factors), robustness-type (kind of robustness), limits (factor limits) or corners (corner points) — or result:<key> once a recommendation stands; result:none means no design of experiments is due in this phase yet. The question itself is a translated text and lives in no field; the recommendation is under recommendation. The field is written only through the commands answer, back and restart.

answers.help: The answers given, one per answered question. Keys and allowed values: phase: define-measure, analyze, improve or control; goal: screening, interactions, optimization, robustness or mixture; screeningCurvature: yes, no or many-factors; factorCount: few or many; factorLevels: two or multi-or-mixed; robustnessType: noise-factors or dispersion-only; limits: expandable or hard; corners: allowed, forbidden or constrained. Questions without an answer are missing. The field is written only through the commands answer, back and restart.

history.help: The ids of the answered questions in the order they were answered; the last entry is the question back returns to. The field is written only through the commands answer, back and restart.

currentOptions.help: The answer options of the open question — exactly the values answer accepts as opt. Empty once the advisor stands on its recommendation.

recommendation.help: The recommended design with five entries: key, name, range of factors, level specification and effort, the texts in the active language as on the result card. Empty while the advisor is still asking a question or no design is due in this phase yet.

answer.help: Answers the open question with one of its options and moves on to the next question — or to the recommendation, when the path ends there. Once a recommendation stands, no question is open; then the answer is rejected.

params.opt: The chosen option of the open question. Which question is open is in currentStep, its options in currentOptions. An option that question does not know is rejected; the message names the allowed ones.
params.command: The command as an object with opt. It returns the new step, that is the next question or result:<key>.

back.help: Goes back one question and discards the answer that led away from it. On the first question there is nothing to go back to; then the call is rejected.

params.command: The command as an empty object; it takes no arguments. It returns the new step, that is the question it went back to.

restart.help: Starts the advisor over: first question, no answers, no trail.

params.command: The command as an empty object; it takes no arguments. It returns the new step, always phase. If the advisor already stands on the first question without answers, it changes nothing.

Recommendation.designId: The key of the recommended design, for example "ccd-rotatable"; the same one the result card holds for the design.
Recommendation.name: The name of the recommended design as a translated text, as it appears in the heading of the result card.
Recommendation.factors: The range of factors the design suits, as a translated text, for example "2–6", as it appears in the result card under "Factors".
Recommendation.levels: The level specification of the design as a translated text, for example "5" or "3+ or mixed", as it appears in the result card under "Levels".
Recommendation.effort: The effort specification of the design as a translated text, for example "2^k runs (e.g. 4 factors = 16)", as it appears in the result card under "Effort".
